messages:
Ana V.: Quick design sync — small follow-up on the playground run row and inline schema inspector. QA hit some usability nits; dropping the list here so we can iterate before the next deploy. :seedling:

Marcus P.: pinged. what are the top items?

Ana V.: 1) label ambiguity: the chevron currently says "Open" on hover but the play icon launches a replay. Users click the wrong thing expecting the player. Propose explicit verbs: "Open details" (chevron) and "Play replay" (play). Update aria-labels accordingly.

Theo (PM): good call. separate verbs map to separate user expectations.

Marcus P.: small implementation detail: change only aria-label text for the icon button to avoid layout shifts. Eg: aria-label="Open details for run 123" vs aria-label="Play replay for run 123".

Ana V.: 2) compact summary line: currently shows code-like signature `summarizeText(...)`. New copy: show a human pill like `Summarize • long→short • 2 args`. On narrow screens collapse to `Summarize • long→short` and provide full content in aria-label.

Marcus P.: will wire pill to have `role="button"` and a full `aria-label` for screen readers. Use CSS ellipsis for truncation.

Theo (PM): can we also show a tiny schema-diff indicator when the function signature changed recently? e.g. `Signature +2` with a subtle icon. Helpful for QA and for users seeing unexpected outputs.

Ana V.: yes — design suggestion: low-contrast border chip + tiny orange delta chevron icon. But accessibility: don't rely on color. include icon + text and `aria-live="polite"` on the chip so screen readers detect it when visible.

Marcus P.: noted. add `title` attribute for hover and ensure contrast meets at least 3:1. If orange fails, use neutral background + colored icon.

Ana V.: 3) inline schema inspector: idea is a lightweight hover/focus preview that shows top 3 fields and types. Should open on hover and on keyboard (Enter/Space) from the function name. Large schemas should show `+n more` and link to full inspector panel.

Marcus P.: perf note: don't render full schema on hover for the whole list. Lazy-load preview data on first hover and cache. Limit to ~3 fields in the tooltip DOM.

Theo (PM): copy for tooltip header: `Schema (preview)` and a footer link `View full schema`.

Ana V.: accessibility: the tooltip must be focusable, provide keyboard open, and be dismissible with Escape. For screen readers, announce `Schema preview for <function>` when opened using `aria-live` or by moving focus into the tooltip.

Marcus P.: will implement tooltip as a focus-trap-free popup that shifts focus to the link inside on keyboard open. That avoids trapping but still announces content.

Ana V.: 4) errors: instead of exposing a raw stack in the row, show calm summary `Tool failed — retry or view details` and hide stack behind `Show error details`. Include invocation id in the summary so support can reference it.

Theo (PM): add `Retry · invocation #abc123` action. microcopy should be short and action-oriented.

Marcus P.: ok to add a small primary `Retry` button next to it and a secondary text control `Show error details`. Ensure keyboard focus order is logical.

Ana V.: 5) keyboard ergonomics: propose `j` / `k` to move between runs (desktop), but disable when any text input is focused. When a run receives focus announce `Focused run: Summarize • long→short` via aria-live and give the focused card a 2px focus ring and slightly darker border.

Theo (PM): also document the shortcuts in the help menu and show a small hint the first time a user visits the run history.

Marcus P.: implementable. we'll gate the hint behind an opt-out localStorage flag.

Ana V.: extra nits: respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand/collapse, ensure pill has `aria-label` with full text, and make the schema-diff chip keyboard-focusable.

Marcus P.: noted. I'll put together a small staging patch: pill copy, aria-labels, aria-expanded on chevrons, tooltip keyboard behavior, error collapse, and j/k nav.

access-bot: Deployed playground run-row + schema preview tweaks to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground (build #2026.5.2) :rocket:

Ana V.: testing now on staging — initial pass looks good. Two follow-ups after testing: 1) make sure screen reader reads the schema-preview header not just the fields, 2) ensure the retry action has an accessible name `Retry invocation <id>` so support callers can hit it by name.

Marcus P.: will do both. I'll open a PR and tag you for a quick review.

Theo (PM): thanks all. if QA signs off quickly we can ship in the next deploy window and include the microcopy updates in the release notes.

Ana V.: thanks — I'll update Figma annotations and the QA checklist. :memo:
